d: Survival and frontier settlement bases in Andy Weir’s Solar System novels.

mars.x: Exploration habitat in Acidalia Planitia where botanist Mark Watney survives for 549 sols using potato farming and hydrazine extraction.

moon.x: Five-sphere pressurized lunar bubble city near Apollo 11, sustained by tourism and solar/nuclear oxygen smelting.

b.s: Rigorous, engineering-focused hard science fiction detailing Mark Watney’s survival on Mars and the lunar city Artemis.
